name: com.ismalicious/mcp-server
title: isMalicious threat intelligence for AI agents
description: Reputation for IPs, domains, URLs, hashes, emails, phones; CVEs; injection and email scans

environmentVariables.name: ISMALICIOUS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key from https://ismalicious.com/app/account. Optional: without it the server starts in bootstrap mode and offers bootstrap_key.

environmentVariables.name: ISMALICIOUS_API_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: API secret paired with the key

environmentVariables.name: ISMALICIOUS_API_BASE
environmentVariables.description: API base URL (defaults to https://ismalicious.com/api; https://api.ismalicious.com reaches the API host directly)

environmentVariables.name: ISMALICIOUS_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Replaces every tool's timeout, in milliseconds (defaults: gate 15000, check_indicator 25000, CVE 10000, search_indicators 20000, check_indicators 60000, check_password_exposure 10000, scan_email 20000). ISMALICIOUS_TIMEOUT_<TOOL>_MS, e.g. ISMALICIOUS_TIMEOUT_CHECK_INDICATOR_MS, sets one tool's timeout and wins over it

environmentVariables.name: ISMALICIOUS_WEB_BASE
environmentVariables.description: Base URL for bootstrap_key, a route only https://ismalicious.com/api serves (defaults to ISMALICIOUS_API_BASE, or https://ismalicious.com/api when that is api.ismalicious.com)

environmentVariables.name: ISMALICIOUS_CACHE_TTL_S
environmentVariables.description: Result cache: 0 turns it off; N caps every tool's cache lifetime at N seconds (never raises one)

environmentVariables.name: ISMALICIOUS_PREWARM
environmentVariables.description: 0 (or false, off, no) skips the one unauthenticated GET /health sent after initialize to open the connection
